name: Venturada (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Venturada (horseshoes and a tower on blue).
history: The flag of Venturada was approved together with the arms on 16 March 1995, published in the BOCM on 18 March 1995 and in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 22 June 1995; it is of proportions 2:3, a red cloth with the municipal arms over all at the centre.
